purpose: A deployment-visible raw-observation-domain diagnostic after q8/BP/residual transport variants were closed.
scope: already-open v111 PoolFire proxy bundles; known nine-view finite-source geometry; noiseless straight-ray proxy; no truth, reconstruction, learned model, resource, external, or real-BOST claim

construction.per_view_scalar: Euclidean magnitude of the two detector-gradient components
construction.motion_estimator: zero-mean Hann-windowed two-dimensional phase correlation independently per view
construction.signal_score: relative reduction in centered detector-magnitude mismatch after zero-filled integer shift of the previous frame

question: Do adjacent observations contain repeatable local detector-domain motion signal before any backprojection, field representation, or truth-aware score is introduced?
roster: v111 five trajectories x three geometries x six held-out coordinate maps x adjacent frozen-frame pairs x nine views
failure_action: Close raw-observation two-dimensional phase transport as a candidate cue under this proxy. Do not train a network or turn it into q8/BP/residual blending.
pass_action: A pass authorizes only a separately frozen geometry-coupled correspondence/representation diagnostic. It does not authorize a warm start, reconstruction, training, resource claim, external generalization, or real-BOST claim.
claim_boundary: Independent per-view detector shifts do not establish a common three-dimensional displacement, especially under finite-source geometry.
